info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
This course is a follow-up to FIN202 and FIN303, in which students touch on fundamental concepts of finance in general and corporate finance in particular. After the theoretical foundation established in FIN202 and FIN303, students now have chance to acquire indepth knowledge about Derivatives valuation and investment strategies.
Topics include: Futures and Forwards Valuation and Strategies, Option Valuation and Strategies, Swaps, Commodity Forwards and Futures, Financial Risk Management.
info.studentTasks:
- Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfil tasks given by intructors after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Read the textbook in advance
- Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

clos.loDetails: Demonstrate an understanding of the uses of financial engineering and risk management approaches and techniques used by modern organisation
Apply their knowledge of derivatives in solving problems involving financial risks including foreign exchange risk, interest rate risk, credit risk and portfolio risks
Make informed judgements on the use of derivative instruments
Identify and assess the impact of seminal developments in the literature on derivatives

assessments.questionType: Each student should make at least 1 individual presentation during the course in front of the class. Topics will be varied based on the topics in the textbook. In addition, students are required to do exercises and other activities

As instructed by the lecturer. Suggestion: 1. Number of Group Members: 4 to 5 students/group2. Analysis and Simulation of a Hedging Strategy Using Derivative Instruments for a Real-World CompanySpecific Requirements:Select a real company operating in Vietnam (e.g., import-export firms, manufacturers using international raw materials, banks, or financial institutions).Analyze key financial risks the company is facing (such as exchange rate risk, interest rate risk, or commodity price risk).Propose a hedging strategy using derivative instruments such as futures, options, or swaps to mitigate the identified risks.Simulate the financial outcome of applying the strategy versus not applying it, using basic financial modeling or spreadsheets.Evaluate the benefits, costs, and potential risks associated with the proposed derivative strategy.Group Deliverables:*Written group report (8–15 pages, in .doc or .pdf format).*Presentation slides (PowerPoint, Canva, or Google Slides).3. Presentation Time in Class:20 minutes per group for presentation10 minutes for Q&A session
Case study: Discuss an example of using one type of Derivatives for Risk management
Multiple choice questions and or small exercises
assessments.noQuestion: At least 20 questions if only MC
